04 / GOOD TO KNOW

Before we
begin.

01Can you build a field-service app for a Ghaziabad team?+

Yes. The app can support assignments, customer details, checklists, documents, status updates and escalation based on the confirmed workflow.

02Can the application connect to an ERP or CRM?+

Often yes when the existing product provides suitable APIs and access. We verify technical and security dependencies before committing to an integration.

03Do you provide maintenance after launch?+

Yes. Monitoring, updates, support response and ongoing improvements are scoped clearly before launch.
